translation.name: Bab dummad Jesucristoba igar mesisad garda

content: Ar ade bela dule-irwa-Bab-Dummadse-gormalad-bur-dummagan-megismalad dulemar-abargi sulegogua, sules-daed, dulemar-irwa Bab-Dummad-asabin gwisguegar, adi Bab Dummadga ibmar-ukleged ukegar, degine, dulemar-iskued-ular Bab Dummadga ibmar-gummakar-ukleged ukegarbar.
Adi dulemar-ibmar-wichurmalad, degine, dulemar-igar-nuedgi-bangudmalad mer mesagwar saegar, ar ade na e-sunnad nolloo gumogad, sunna iskumogad.
A-ulale, na e-iskued-ular, degine, dulemar-iskued-ular Bab Dummadga ibmar-ukleged uker-gebed.
Deginbali, dule na-dukin geg san-odummoged dule-irwa-Bab-Dummadse-goled-bur-dummadga na nugsanai-gued. Unnila Bab Dummad ese goler-gebed, igi Aarónse Bab Dummad gocha-gusmogadyob.
Ar deyobi Cristo na-dukin na san-odummossulid na dule-irwa-Bab-Dummadse-goled-bur-dummadga na-dukin nug imaksasulid, Bab Dummad ega sogsa-gusad:

Cristo we-napneggi dula gudigua, Bab Dummad sunna burgwedgi e-onogoedse ibyanis-abalagi binnasuli gornai, egi ise-wilenai-gusad. Bab Dummad we-Cristo-ese-binnasur-gochad itosad, ar ade Cristo nue uaya-nikaa-nanadigusadba Bab-Dummad-itosad.
Ar Cristo Bab-Dummad-Machi-inigwele, na nue-wilesadbali durdaksad, Bab Dummadba ib-saed.
Agi nue durdaksasoggu, bela dulemar-eba-ib-saed abonoged-degi-sadeguadga gunonisunnad.
Geb degine, Bab Dummad sognonisunnad, Melquisedecyob be dule-irwa-Bab-Dummadse-goled-bur-dummadga an be-nug imaksunye.
Bab Dummadba nagusar, egi gannar bangued, we bonisailad
We-igargangine, bukidar anmar egi sunmaked nika-inigwele, degite, nuegwadsuun bela bega sogele, dutusulid, ar ade bemar amba nue aku-itomalad.

Ar bemar bato dikasurgus odurdaked-sailaga gusa-wilubmalanad, emigindi amba bemarga gannar sogmalar-gebed, gebesaila Bab-Dummad-gaya-burba-onodedgi. Ar bemar deyob gunonisoggu, amba bemar nunis gober-gebed, ar amba san geg be gunmalad.
Ar dule amba nunis gobnaile, amba Bab-Dummad-gaya-burba-napiragwad nue wichulid, ar ade amba Bab Dummadgi mimmigwa gued.
Ar san-gunmaladdi bato wedi dulemar-nue-Bab-Dummad-igargi-nasgusmaladgadid, ar na gusgu Bab-Dummad-igarba-gudiidbali wissunnad, igid igar-nuedi, degine, igid igar-iskanabali.
